in_marathi.name: Sukhlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Happiness, Joy, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sukh meaning happiness, lal meaning red or passion. Sukhlal is a name which signifies a person who is full of joy and happiness.
